title: AI4Plasma II: Geometry-Aware Surrogate Modeling for Variable Electrode Gap GEC Plasmas
abstract: arXiv:2611.15584v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Industrial plasma process development requires broad exploration of operating and geometric parameters. Geometric parameters, particularly electrode spacing, affect discharge structure and processing uniformity. Exploring these parameter spaces through repeated high-fidelity simulations can be computationally expensive. Surrogate models can offer rapid predictions, but geometric variation complicates their application because the computational domain and discretization may change across samples.   In this work, six geometry-aware surrogate models based on prescribed and learned geometry mappings, extended-domain representation, continuous coordinates, and geometry-native discretizations are compared in terms of their data requirements for accurate predictions of full plasma fields and ion density profiles near the wafer. translated_title: AI4Plasma II：面向可变电极间距GEC等离子体的几何感知代理建模
translated_abstract: 工业等离子体工艺的开发需要对运行参数和几何参数进行广泛探索。几何参数，尤其是电极间距，会影响放电结构和工艺均匀性。通过反复进行高保真度仿真来探索这些参数空间可能带来高昂的计算成本。代理模型虽然能够提供快速预测，但几何变化使其应用变得复杂，因为不同样本之间的计算域和离散化方式可能各不相同。在本工作中，比较了六种几何感知代理模型——分别基于预设和学习的几何映射、扩展域表示、连续坐标以及几何原生离散化——在准确预测完整等离子体场以及晶圆附近离子密度分布方面所需的数据量。仿真数据集涵盖气压、电压、频率和电极间距，每个参考算例需要……（原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 该研究比较了六种几何感知代理模型在可变电极间距GEC等离子体仿真中的数据需求，以实现对完整等离子体场和晶圆附近离子密度分布的快速准确预测。
en_tdlr: This work compares six geometry-aware surrogate models in terms of their data requirements for accurately predicting full plasma fields and near-wafer ion density profiles in GEC plasmas with variable electrode gaps.
